'''Frenil Alagar''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] representative sent to investigate the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Frenil pointed out in his report that, even for unimportant worlds of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]] and [[Derilyn]] had wonderful cultures and the same level of sophistication as other worlds found in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]].
